method.step: Enumerate every contiguous run of `min_stmts` or more statements in every block in the codebase.
Alpha-normalize each run (locals, generics, and lifetimes renamed to placeholders by first-seen order) and bucket runs that share a canonical form; a bucket with 2+ members is a duplicate group.
Suppress dominated spans: a smaller fragment that only appears nested inside a larger, equally-or-more-duplicated fragment is dropped, so only maximal clones are reported.
